searchMethod: Qualitative search intent research using current indexed results for branded company referral terms, operational data licensing, AI lab data sales, qualification, payouts, and privacy. No keyword-volume provider or Search Console query data was accessed. These are plausible query targets, not measured search volumes or ranking forecasts.
observedSearchLandscape: micro1's own company-referral page and current terms are prominent branded sources.
Many micro1 review pages focus on individual expert jobs and candidate referrals, creating an editorial distinction for a business-focused report.
Operational data licensing pages from Polyshares, Aribase, Imladris Labs, and other intermediaries address sell business data and license company data intent.
Older June company program pages describe $25,000, while current pages advertise up to $50,000. Current dated evidence is useful to searchers resolving contradictory information.

criticalDistinctions: Seller compensation is separate from referrer rewards.
$100K+, $500K+, and $1M+ are advertised individually assessed compensation bands, not fixed products or promised annual income.
Broad enterprise material says 30+ employees; the live selected enterprise listing says 30 to 200.
Commercial video lists 20+ employees as preferred and has a separate geographic list.
The selected link currently contains both enterprise and commercial video opportunities, not just one enterprise posting.
The user screenshots show $50,000 and $1,500 referral amounts, not completed payouts or company rates.
The September 24 terms have a 7.5% default only when no company referral payout is specified.
Existing prospects can be excluded; consent, thresholds, conflicts disclosure, and confirmed payable status matter.
Microsoft is named by the founder in training context; Box is named in a Cortex evaluation case study. Neither establishes use of the company referral data program.
Raw data deletion and retained underlying ownership do not define derivative dataset deletion or licensed rights.
No program-specific certification or independent payment distribution was established from the primary materials reviewed.
